m.d: Your equipment is the things that you use to do a job or sport.
m.e: Soccer is a popular game because you need very little equipment to play--just a ball and an open space.

m.d: Someone who has the same rights as somebody else.
m.e: I'm your teacher, not your equal.

m.d: If x equals y, x and y have the same value.
If two things are equal, they are the same in shape, size, or number.
m.e: The number of people inside of the store is equal to the number of people outside of the store.

m.d: If something is equally distributed, it is distributed into equal parts.
An equivalent is something of equal value of acceptability.
m.e: Living in Thailand costs the equivalent of just £10 per day.

m.d: If two things are equivalent, they are of equal value or acceptability.
m.e: Dolphins have very large brains, roughly equivalent to the size of a human brain.

m.d: An equation is a mathematical statement in which both sides are of equal value.
m.e: Find x, in the equation x+2y=3y.

m.d: An equation is how everything works together to create a situation.
m.e: Money plays a big part in the political equation.

m.d: The equation of x with y, is the act of thinking about them as the same or as belonging together.
m.e: The equation of women with maids and cooks must stop.

m.d: The state of being equal, of having the same value.
The equal treatment of all people even if they are different.
The equator is the line that separates the Northern Hemisphere and Southern Hemisphere equally.
m.e: The climate around the equator is very humid.

m.d: When something is at equilibrium, it is balanced and different types of influences are the same, hence having no net change.
m.e: The population of the ants in this area has reached an equilibrium.

m.d: When an object is at equilibrium, it is at rest or continuous motion and all the forces acting on it cancels out to become zero.
When a system is in equilibrium, the rates of the forward and backward reactions are the same, hence causing no change in the concentration of the reactants…
m.e: When a weak acid is added into water, an equilibrium mixture is obtained.

m.d: If you equip a person or a place, you give them equipment.
m.e: We equipped the buses with blankets and pillows and high-tech stereo headphones and telephones.

m.d: If you equip someone with skills or knowledge, you teach it to them.
m.e: This program equips students with the skills they need to succeed in college.
